answer: Tie each agent's identity to an anchor stake that only unlocks after a full epoch of honest work, so a sybil farm must park real capital for weeks per fake account. Random audits sample agents along the reputation ridge: those caught copying answers lose their stake and their plume of accumulated trust in one slash. Creating thousands of identities then costs thousands of locked deposits plus the compute to keep each one plausibly active, while honest agents pay nothing beyond the deposit they get back.
